entities.description: Condition where back-off timer is deactivated.

entities.description: Condition where back-off timer value is zero.

relations.description: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message contains Back-off timer value IE.
BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message contains Re-attempt indicator IE.
BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message contains ESM cause IE.
When timer value is neither zero nor deactivated, UE starts back-off timer.
When timer value is neither zero nor deactivated, UE does not send BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST until timer expires.
When timer is deactivated, UE does not send BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST until UE is switched off or USIM removed.
When timer value is zero, UE may send another BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST.
Back-off timer value IE guards condition for timer value being neither zero nor deactivated.
Back-off timer value IE guards condition for timer being deactivated.
Back-off timer value IE guards condition for timer value being zero.
